scope_assessment: An explicit uniform exact k-clique counting algorithm reduces to one integer matrix multiplication on at most n^ceil(k/3) rows/columns. Strassen gives O(n^(log2(7)ceil(k/3))) integer arithmetic operations, plus compatibility construction, with polynomial-size integer operands and explicit bit/address accounting. This established XP algorithm is not FPT.
